# FreeRTOS-Kernel upstream revision

- Repository: https://github.com/FreeRTOS/FreeRTOS-Kernel
- Release: V11.3.0
- Commit: `9b777ae5c5b8e9e456065a00294d1e5f5f9facf5`
- Licence: MIT (`LICENSE.md`)
- Retrieved: 2026-08-11

This directory is an unmodified, minimal source snapshot. It contains the
generic kernel sources and headers needed by FreeWisp, plus the `heap_4`
memory allocator. FreeWisp-specific configuration and the Emscripten port live
outside this directory.
